case: MySQL/MariaDB TIME(3) fractional storage mode semantics
contract: Each test clears session sql_mode for the baseline and inserts 12:34:56.789900 into TIME(3) using both a bound parameter and a generated SQL literal.
With TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL absent, MySQL stores .790; with it enabled, MySQL stores .789.
With TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL absent, MariaDB stores .789; with it enabled, MariaDB stores .790.
Both write paths are checked against the returned TIME value, CAST(value AS CHAR), and native MICROSECOND(value).

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other temporal types, precisions, and fractional values remain untested.
Other SQL modes, consumer paths, and installed typed edits remain open.
This bounded contract does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
